feeds.title: Gay League Blog
feeds.description: The Gay League is one of the first and largest groups in the world for LGBT comics fans. The group had its start in the summer of 1997 after a man enigmatically referred to as 'Ulu Vakk' attended Andy Mangels' 'Gays In Comics' panel at San Diego Comic Con. The panel served as inspiration for bringing LGBT fans together online. It seemed the perfect solution to the few people who were posting campy and very gay remarks on the old DC Comics message board
